GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 620 (5 May 51) ESS/FIN
(SCAPIN-2151)
APO 500
5 May 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Requisition of Japanese Government Corporation for Housing Allied Personnel Houses by Occupation Forces.
1. Effective this date all houses owned by the Japanese Government Corporation for Housing Allied Personnel which have been constructed for use by Occupation Forces are declared subject to procurement demand.
2. Separate requisitions will be made for such housing in accordance with existing procedures, at which time the Termination of War (Works) appropriation will pay the Corporation \32,400 monthly rental for each requisitioned house.
3. Pending requisition, present methods of rental payments will continue in force.
4. Any portions of previous memoranda from this headquarters on this subject that are inconsistent with provisions of this memorandum are rescinded.
5. Direct communication is hereby authorized with appropriate agencies of this headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
GEORGE R. CONNOR,
Colonel, AGC
Acting Adjutant General.
